summary: Recorded the differential that decides how the VerifyLeader finding should be read: the election vote path (electSelf, preElectSelf) iterates the leader's latest configuration and solicits or counts only servers whose Suffrage is Voter, while verifyLeader asks every replication peer — and the granting side (requestVote) imposes no suffrage requirement on the granter, so a non-voter would have granted a vote had it been asked. Added that as a Behaviour (@elect_voter_only_solicitation) with three new source ranges, re-stated the verify question's account with the contrast and an explicit knowledge use, and left its evidence, executions and gap answers unchanged. Remaining work: confirm the knowledge use resolved to a concrete entry id; the verify question's stale-read consequence is still conditional on the unregistered successor-overlap condition. A read of the staged-commit-index path found no defect — restoreFromCommittedLogs clamps a staged index to the log's last index, so staging before StoreLogs cannot commit entries a follower never stored — so no suspicion was registered from it.
